apps.localizedDescription: View your Mac's system activity on iPhone over a local encrypted connection. A native, local-first system monitor with a lightweight Mac companion and a mobile dashboard.

versions.localizedDescription:
Stats iPhone 0.3.10 puts optional Disk read/write speeds and custom Disk text inside the Storage card. The card expands when either option is enabled in System activity settings.

All iPhone settings switches now provide haptic feedback when changed, following the Haptics preference. The Haptics switch itself confirms both on and off changes.
